sections.title: Clothes words
sections.content: This unit is about what people wear. You know *ing*, *póló*, *nadrág*, *kabát* and *cipő*; here are five more: *szoknya* (skirt), *ruha* (dress), *sapka* (hat), *pulóver* (jumper) and *zokni* (sock). To name a thing, use *Ez egy …* for something near and *Az egy …* for something farther away, and ask *Mi ez?* After a number the noun stays singular (*két zokni*). Without a number, several things take *-k*; a final *-a* lengthens first.

items.english: What is this? This is a skirt.

sections.content: Do not use both a number and *-k*: *két zokni*, never *két zoknik*. *Pulóver* ends in a consonant and takes the linking vowel *-e-*: *pulóverek*.
